headline: native100 evidence_bottleneck shows NO measurable held-out learning of the assertion decision; it does not separate from an untrained control or from the majority class.

evaluator_defect.defect: NOT A CAPABILITY MEASUREMENT — gold value is injected into the candidate set
evaluator_defect.mechanism: p1_eval._propose_case passes raw_value=spec.raw_value into generate_target_line; inference.build_target_candidates then constructs 'ASSERTED: {raw_value}', 'DENIED: {raw_value}', 'UNCERTAIN: {raw_value}', 'NOT_MENTIONED'. The gold span is therefore present in the candidate set by construction and the model only selects an assertion prefix. exact_gold_span and support_direct_exact are near-tautological under this harness and must not be reported as evidence-transport capability (briefing SS VII, SS XLIX 'evaluator bug').
evaluator_defect.implication: Native evidence-transport capability is currently UNMEASURED, not demonstrated.

correct_abstention.note: model never correctly abstains; 66/150 gold atoms are silently omitted rather than abstained — omission is not abstention (briefing SS L SELECTIVITY)

malformed.note: the one clear training effect: well-formedness improved 48 -> 11

support_direct_exact_rate.note: trained is WORSE here; tautological metric, do not act on it

training_regime.note: final train loss is 1.84x worse than the step-160 minimum; 34 epochs over 96 examples is a memorization regime. Low train loss here is not evidence of capability.

did_not: improve assertion-state accuracy above an untrained control (+0.0007)
improve assertion-state accuracy above majority class (+0.0111, inside CI)
produce any correct abstention (0/150 both before and after)

decision.rationale: Briefing SS LV: promotion requires evidence a mechanism improves capability. The only held-out metric that reflects a model decision (assertion_state) is statistically indistinguishable from both an untrained control and majority-class guessing. Ranking evidence_bottleneck vs span_port on final train loss would be ranking memorization.
do_not: declare evidence_bottleneck the winner on train loss
report exact_gold_span_rate=1.0 as evidence transport capability
required_next: fix the evaluator so raw_value is not injected into the candidate set (free, local) — until then evidence transport is unmeasured
add majority-class and random-init controls as standing baselines in the native eval harness
select checkpoints by held-out metric, not last step (step 160 beat step 200 on train loss)
increase training data or reduce epochs — 96 examples x 34 epochs cannot support a 100M model
power: 84 eligible atoms cannot detect a ~1pp effect; either enlarge the eval or target larger effects
